verses.en: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
verses.pt: Depois entraram Moisés e Arão a Faraó, e lhe disseram: O SENHOR, o Deus de Israel, disse assim: Deixa ir meu povo a celebrar-me festa no deserto.
verses.en_web: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’”
verses.en_bbe: And after that, Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh, and said, The Lord, the God of Israel, says, Let my people go so that they may keep a feast to me in the waste land.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.
verses.pt: E Faraó respondeu: Quem é o SENHOR, para que eu ouça sua voz e deixe ir a Israel? Não conheço o SENHOR, nem tampouco deixarei Israel ir.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord, to whose voice I am to give ear and let Israel go? I have no knowledge of the Lord and I will not let Israel go.

verses.en: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days’ journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
verses.pt: E eles disseram: O Deus dos hebreus nos encontrou: iremos, pois, agora caminho de três dias pelo deserto, e sacrificaremos ao SENHOR nosso Deus; para que não venha sobre nós com pestilência ou com espada.
verses.en_web: They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh, our God, lest he fall on us with pestilence, or with the sword.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, The God of the Hebrews has come to us: let us then go three days' journey into the waste land to make an offering to the Lord our God, so that he may not send death on us by disease or the sword.

verses.en: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
verses.pt: Então o rei do Egito lhes disse: Moisés e Arão, por que fazeis cessar ao povo de sua obra? Ide a vossas cargas.
verses.en_web: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”
verses.en_bbe: And the king of Egypt said to them, Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people away from their work? get back to your work.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
verses.pt: Disse também Faraó: Eis que o povo da terra é agora muito, e vós lhes fazeis cessar de suas cargas.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh said, Truly, the people of the land are increasing in number, and you are keeping them back from their work.

verses.en: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
verses.pt: E mandou Faraó aquele mesmo dia aos capatazes do povo que o tinham à sua responsabilidade, e a seus governadores, dizendo:
verses.en_web: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
verses.en_bbe: The same day Pharaoh gave orders to the overseers and those who were responsible for the work, saying,

verses.en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
verses.pt: De aqui adiante não dareis palha ao povo para fazer tijolos, como ontem e antes de ontem; vão eles e recolham por si mesmos a palha;
verses.en_web: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.
verses.en_bbe: Give these men no more dry stems for their brick-making as you have been doing; let them go and get the material for themselves.

verses.en: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.
verses.pt: E haveis de pôr-lhes a tarefa dos tijolos que faziam antes, e não lhes diminuireis nada; porque estão ociosos, e por isso levantam a voz dizendo: Vamos e sacrificaremos a nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: The number of the bricks, which they made before, you require from them. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle; therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’
verses.en_bbe: But see that they make the same number of bricks as before, and no less: for they have no love for work; and so they are crying out and saying, Let us go and make an offering to our God.

verses.en: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.
verses.pt: Agrave-se a servidão sobre eles, para que se ocupem nela, e não atendam a palavras de mentira.
verses.en_web: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it; and don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”
verses.en_bbe: Give the men harder work, and see that they do it; let them not give attention to false words.

verses.en: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
verses.pt: E saindo os capatazes do povo e seus governadores, falaram ao povo, dizendo: Assim disse Faraó: Eu não vos dou palha.
verses.en_web: The taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.
verses.en_bbe: And the overseers of the people and their responsible men went out and said to the people, Pharaoh says, I will give you no more dry stems.

verses.en: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
verses.pt: Ide vós, e recolhei palha de onde a achardes; que nada se diminuirá de vossa tarefa.
verses.en_web: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”
verses.en_bbe: Go yourselves and get dry stems wherever you are able; for your work is not to be any less.

verses.en: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
verses.pt: Então o povo se espalhou por toda a terra do Egito a colher restolho em lugar de palha.
verses.en_web: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
verses.en_bbe: So the people were sent in all directions through the land of Egypt to get dry grass for stems.

verses.en: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
verses.pt: E os capatazes os apressavam, dizendo: Acabai vossa obra, a tarefa do dia em seu dia, como quando se vos dava palha.
verses.en_web: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”
verses.en_bbe: And the overseers went on driving them and saying, Do your full day's work as before when there were dry stems for you.

verses.en: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
verses.pt: E açoitavam aos supervisores dos filhos de Israel, que os capatazes de Faraó haviam posto sobre eles, dizendo: Por que não cumpristes vossa tarefa de tijolos nem ontem nem hoje, como antes?
verses.en_web: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”
verses.en_bbe: And the responsible men of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh's overseers had put over them, were given blows, and they said to them, Why have you not done your regular work, in making bricks as before?

verses.en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
verses.pt: E os supervisores dos filhos de Israel vieram a Faraó, e se queixaram a ele, dizendo: Por que o fazes assim com teus servos?
verses.en_web: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?
verses.en_bbe: Then the responsible men of the children of Israel came to Pharaoh, protesting and saying, Why are you acting in this way to your servants?

verses.en: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.
verses.pt: Não se dá palha a teus servos, e, contudo, nos dizem: Fazei os tijolos. E eis que teus servos são açoitados, e teu povo cai em falta.
verses.en_web: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”
verses.en_bbe: They give us no dry stems and they say to us, Make bricks: and they give your servants blows; but it is your people who are in the wrong.

verses.en: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the LORD.
verses.pt: E ele respondeu: Estais ociosos, sim, ociosos, e por isso dizeis: Vamos e sacrifiquemos ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: But he said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to Yahweh.’
verses.en_bbe: But he said, You have no love for work: that is why you say, Let us go and make an offering to the Lord.

verses.en: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
verses.pt: Ide, pois, agora, e trabalhai. Não se vos dará palha, e haveis de dar a tarefa dos tijolos.
verses.en_web: Go therefore now, and work, for no straw shall be given to you, yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”
verses.en_bbe: Go now, get back to your work; no dry stems will be given to you, but you are to make the full number of bricks.

verses.en: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.
verses.pt: Então os supervisores dos filhos de Israel se viram em aflição, tendo lhes dito: Não se diminuirá nada de vossos tijolos, da tarefa de cada dia.
verses.en_web: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble, when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”
verses.en_bbe: Then the responsible men of the children of Israel saw that they were purposing evil when they said, The number of bricks which you have to make every day will be no less than before.

verses.en: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
verses.pt: E encontrando a Moisés e a Arão, que estavam à vista deles quando saíam de Faraó,
verses.en_web: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came out from Pharaoh:
verses.en_bbe: And they came face to face with Moses and Aaron, who were in their way when they came out from Pharaoh:

verses.en: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
verses.pt: Disseram-lhes: Olhe o SENHOR sobre vós, e julgue; pois nos fizestes repulsivos diante de Faraó e de seus servos, dando-lhes a espada nas mãos para que nos matem.
verses.en_web: and they said to them, “May Yahweh look at you, and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to them, May the Lord take note of you and be your judge; for you have given Pharaoh and his servants a bad opinion of us, putting a sword in their hands for our destruction.

verses.en: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
verses.pt: Então Moisés se voltou ao SENHOR, e disse: Senhor, por que afliges a este povo? para que me enviaste?
verses.en_web: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?
verses.en_bbe: And Moses went back to the Lord and said, Lord, why have you done evil to this people? why have you sent me?

verses.en: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
verses.pt: Porque desde que vim a Faraó para falar-lhe em teu nome, afligiu a este povo; e tu tampouco livraste a teu povo.
verses.en_web: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people; and you have not rescued your people at all.”
verses.en_bbe: For from the time when I came to Pharaoh to put your words before him, he has done evil to this people, and you have given them no help.
